description: Creates a scene file where none is, saves one, or saves a copy under a new path. create makes a folder the path names that is not there, and names it under madeFolder; its answer names the root's type and name, and under script the script the root carries. A save of a scene open in the editor saves the editor's copy, unsaved changes included. Through the editor when one serves the project; with none, a headless engine runs the editor's own tool and the answer says so under writtenBy, or readBy for a read. That engine runs every script of the file, where the editor runs only tool scripts, so what a script changes as the file loads or as a property is set is put back before anything is saved, and a file where that cannot be done, such as a scene whose script does not compile, is refused and nothing is written. Each file the written one refers to is named by its uid, as the editor names it, except a file the project's uid cache has no uid for yet (one made since the project was last scanned), which is named by path and listed under namedByPath with the call that scans it. An editor of the project that is running and has not reached this server is waited for rather than written around. A scene is saved as the engine holds it once the file has loaded, and one property can set others as it loads, as anchors_preset gives a centred Control both its grow directions, so a scene not last saved by an editor can gain, change or lose lines on nodes the call did not name: alsoSaved lists each as {node, property, was, saved}, was left out where the file set nothing and saved where it now sets nothing. The scene loads as it did; only its text changed. Operations: create: a new scene with one root node; save: save the scene as it is in the editor, or as the file loads when the editor does not have it open; from says which; save_as (needs newPath): save a copy under newPath. Default create.

inherits.description: create: a scene for the new one to inherit, such as "parts/crate.tscn", as the editor's New Inherited Scene makes one. Its root is an instance of that scene, so changes there reach it, and scene_node set gives the nodes it inherits values of this scene's own. The root's class is that scene's, so rootNodeType is not given with it; the answer names it under rootNodeType and the scene under inherits. Only for op create.

newPath.description: save_as: where the copy goes. Only for op save_as.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

rootNodeName.description: create: the root node name. Default the class name, as the editor names a new root, or with inherits the name of that scene's root. Only for op create.

rootNodeType.description: create: the root node class, an engine class or a class_name a project script declares, which the root is made as with that script attached. Default Node. Only for op create.

scenePath.description: Scene file inside the project, such as "scenes/main.tscn" or "res://scenes/main.tscn".

script.description: create: a script to attach to the root. Only for op create.

name: scene_create
title: Create or save a scene
